output.body:
## Summary

```text
retained menu / shared stage
  └ CreditsPanel → CreditsMotion → native or mock artwork
                 └ offline website feedback
About this recreation → attribution / asset report
```

Replace generic Credits with the authored timeline, copy, placements and Back hover. Keep the parent menu alive through the existing action guard, supply local feedback for historical links, and move recreation details outside the game stage. Builds on merged #34.

## Evidence

- **Before:** generic Credits content and lower menu status badges.
  **After:** native/mock browser cases preserve frames1/9/34, stop after100 extra frames, Back hover paint/state, all three offline destinations, no outbound requests/popups, and return to the retained menu. The asset report remains available in About.
- Formatting, TypeScript,454 rule/parser tests /5777 assertions and production build pass. All10 affected native/mock Credits/menu/game cases and the full58-case mock/synthetic selection pass. Prior layout-effect focus, hotkey/input and preferred-FPS corrections remain intact.
- Settled foreground inspected against an owned Ruffle run of the unmodified original SWF. Playwright handled canvas coordinates; REA passively captured the final viewport. Complete Evidence and loaded JS/WASM/SWF identities are retained locally. Different backdrop, particles, guest/version, local feedback and Back hover prevent a synchronized pixel claim; this is not Adobe parity.
- Runtime artwork comes from the supplied SWF. Mock glyphs/logo are procedural approximations. Native/mock view setup uses layout-phase subscription, retained motion, refs, asynchronous cancellation and cleanup. No original media is committed.
- Comparison identified an existing separate menu defect:487 is painted despite original556 placing it atdepth1/clipDepth2 as a nonpainting mask. Its tint and lower-right outline will be corrected in a separate small PR. Background/particles, series controls, MouseUp/click event delivery, global phase and exact text/filter pixels also remain open. Complete Credits/menu/game parity is unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** menus

Changes Credits, asset preparation and About placement. Historical destinations remain disconnected behind the replaceable offline adapter.

## Summary

```text
retained menu / shared stage
  └ CreditsPanel → CreditsMotion → native or mock artwork
                 └ offline website feedback
About this recreation → attribution / asset report
```

Replace generic Credits with the authored timeline, copy, placements and Back hover. Keep the parent menu alive through the existing action guard, supply local feedback for historical links, and move recreation details outside the game stage. Builds on merged #34.

## Evidence

- **Before:** generic Credits content and lower menu status badges.
  **After:** native/mock browser cases preserve frames1/9/34, stop after100 extra frames, Back hover paint/state, all three offline destinations, no outbound requests/popups, and return to the retained menu. The asset report remains available in About.
- Formatting, TypeScript,454 rule/parser tests /5777 assertions and production build pass. All10 affected native/mock Credits/menu/game cases and the full58-case mock/synthetic selection pass. Prior layout-effect focus, hotkey/input and preferred-FPS corrections remain intact.
- Settled foreground inspected against an owned Ruffle run of the unmodified original SWF. Playwright handled canvas coordinates; REA passively captured the final viewport. Complete Evidence and loaded JS/WASM/SWF identities are retained locally. Different backdrop, particles, guest/version, local feedback and Back hover prevent a synchronized pixel claim; this is not Adobe parity.
- Runtime artwork comes from the supplied SWF. Mock glyphs/logo are procedural approximations. Native/mock view setup uses layout-phase subscription, retained motion, refs, asynchronous cancellation and cleanup. No original media is committed.
- Comparison identified an existing separate menu defect:487 is painted despite original556 placing it atdepth1/clipDepth2 as a nonpainting mask. Its tint and lower-right outline will be corrected in a separate small PR. Background/particles, series controls, MouseUp/click event delivery, global phase and exact text/filter pixels also remain open. Complete Credits/menu/game parity is unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** menus

Changes Credits, asset preparation and About placement. Historical destinations remain disconnected behind the replaceable offline adapter.

+

Standalone renderer fixtures use the same gradient without an independent animated background clock.

Its constructor overwrites the third argument with `false`, so both layers have parent alpha 0.5, pixel particles and no glow/blur. `_‑LF`'s large rising bubbles are gated by `GameData._‑MH=false`; the mock menu's invented stationary circles and tiled dots were removed. Each layer creates five particles, replenishes from the preceding visited count (therefore visits 20 on its first frame), emits at counters 5/10, randomly unlinks next nodes at counters 2/3/4/5/10, and marks low-alpha/out-of-bounds nodes for later removal. ## Summary

```diff
 MainMenuView
-  paint487 as a background
+  omit nonpainting depth1/clipDepth2 mask
   retain title / control timelines
```

Remove the unintended gray tint and lower-right white outline observed during the original Credits comparison. Original556 places487 as a mask; all manually rendered controls start above its clip range. Stacked above #35. This extracts an independent correction from the later series-strip backlog.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the native pixel regression fails on the original renderer restored exactly from the parent commit.
  **After:** both empty-region comparisons pass with the mask omitted. Updated native Credits was inspected with the outline absent; retained intro/fades/guard/title179, Back hover and offline feedback still pass.
- The fixture temporarily uses a solid backdrop, compares canvas shown/hidden on the same frozen frame, then restores normal visibility/gradient before navigation. Comparisons stay exact. The first gradient probe exposed compositor dithering (45/200 pixels, maximum one channel value); no tolerance or product color change was added.
- Formatting, TypeScript,454 rule/parser tests /5777 assertions, production build and all four affected native/mock menu/Credits cases pass. Temporary debug attachments were removed.
- Raw SWF placement/shape facts and the preceding original-runtime capture support the correction. No generated data or media changes. Preserve this removal when the series-strip checkpoint lands.
- Shared background/particles, series controls, hit contours, event delivery, global phase and exact filter/text pixels remain separate work. This closes the observed mask-paint defect, not complete menu/game parity.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** rendering

Removes one incorrectly painted native menu object. The retained child timelines and mock layout remain intact. Requires #35 first.
